Record Class StudentInfo

java.lang.Object
java.lang.Record
edu.ucsb.cs156.frontiers.models.StudentInfo
Record Components:
email - the student's email as stored on the roster
firstName - the shortest unique name for the student
legalFirstName - the roster's first name field, unchanged
lastName - the roster's last name field, unchanged
githubLogin - the student's GitHub login, or null if they have not linked GitHub yet
team - the name of the student's team (the first one, if they are on several), or null if they are not on a team
teams - the names of all the student's teams, possibly empty
teamMembers - everyone on team, including the student, or empty if the student has no team
public record StudentInfo(String email, String firstName, String legalFirstName, String lastName, String githubLogin, String team, List<String> teams, List<StudentInfo.Member> teamMembers) extends Record
What an autograder needs to know about one roster student: how to recognise them on GitHub, which team they are on, and who else is on that team. This is the response of GET /api/courses/studentInfo.

The firstName fields hold the shortest name that still identifies the student among all the (non-dropped) students of the course, as computed by TeamCsvService.nameAndTeams(List): e.g. "Chris" if there is only one Chris, "Chris L" if there are several. That is the name a teammate is likely to use for them. The legalFirstName fields hold the roster's first name field as is.
